_readme: This is the whole event. Nothing here is hard-coded in the app.
To run the portal for another event, copy this file and change it.
Every name, bio and link below is invented placeholder content. Replace
before the event. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the
validator, so you can leave notes like this one anywhere in the file.
Validated by src/lib/event-schema.ts. Run 'npm run dev' to see errors.

sessions.title: Registration and light lunch
sessions.description: Collect your name tag at the desk. Scan the QR code on the front of your tag so we know you have arrived.

sessions.title: Welcome and opening remarks
sessions.description: Why we are here, how the three days work, and what we want to walk away with.
objectives: Understand the purpose of the summit
Know how the three days fit together

sessions.title: Ice breaker: who is in the room
sessions.description: A quick live poll game. Open Slido on your phone and answer as fast as you can.
objectives: Meet people from other divisions
Warm up for the working sessions

sessions.title: Keynote: powering the nation through change
sessions.description: The outlook for the next three years, what it asks of leaders, and the decisions ahead of us.
objectives: Understand the three year outlook
See where leadership attention is needed most
Hear the questions the board is asking

sessions.title: Coffee break
sessions.description: Refreshments in the foyer.

sessions.title: Panel: leading through uncertainty
sessions.description: Three leaders on what changed their mind this year. Bring your questions to Slido.
objectives: Hear how peers handle competing priorities
Collect practical habits you can try next week

sessions.title: Day 1 wrap and housekeeping
sessions.description: What happens tonight and what to bring tomorrow.

sessions.title: Free time
sessions.description: Check in to your room and freshen up.

sessions.title: Welcome dinner
sessions.description: Seated dinner. Table numbers are on your name tag.

sessions.title: Night activity: the power challenge
sessions.description: Mixed teams, light competition, no preparation needed. Song requests go through Slido.
objectives: Build trust across divisions in a relaxed setting

days.label: Day 2
days.subtitle: Full working day, breakouts and gala dinner

sessions.title: Breakfast
sessions.description: Buffet breakfast. Please scan your name tag at the desk on your way in.

sessions.title: Morning energiser
sessions.description: Short standing activity to start the day.

sessions.title: Strategy briefing: where we are and what is next
sessions.description: The numbers behind the plan, the gaps, and the three bets for 2027.
objectives: Know the three strategic bets for 2027
Understand how your division contributes
Leave with the questions your team will ask you

sessions.title: Coffee break
sessions.description: Refreshments in the foyer. Breakout rooms open at 10:25.

sessions.title: Breakout A: delivery and reliability
sessions.description: Working session. Your group is on your name tag. Output goes on the wall for the report back.
objectives: Agree the top three delivery blockers
Write one owner and one date against each

sessions.title: Breakout B: digital and data
sessions.description: Working session. Your group is on your name tag. Output goes on the wall for the report back.
objectives: Pick the two data problems worth fixing first
Name what you will stop doing to make room

sessions.title: Breakout C: people and capability
sessions.description: Working session. Your group is on your name tag. Output goes on the wall for the report back.
objectives: Identify the capability gap that hurts most in 2027
Agree one change each leader will make

sessions.title: Lunch
sessions.description: Buffet lunch in the foyer.

sessions.title: Breakout report back
sessions.description: Ten minutes per group, then open discussion. Vote on priorities in Slido.
objectives: Hear all three groups in one place
Agree which items go to the leadership agenda

sessions.title: Coffee break
sessions.description: Refreshments in the foyer.

sessions.title: Fireside chat: the leader people want to follow
sessions.description: An honest conversation about hard feedback, trust and energy.
objectives: Name one habit to drop and one to start
Practise giving feedback that lands

sessions.title: Free time
sessions.description: Gala dinner is smart casual.

sessions.title: Gala dinner and recognition
sessions.description: Dinner, awards and something we have not told you about yet.

sessions.title: Breakfast
sessions.description: Buffet breakfast. Please check out of your room before the morning session.

sessions.title: Leadership masterclass: making change stick
sessions.description: What actually survives contact with a busy quarter, and how to protect it.
objectives: Understand why most change efforts fade by March
Pick a tracking habit that takes under ten minutes a week

sessions.title: Coffee break
sessions.description: Last one. Group photo straight after the closing address.

sessions.title: Commitments and next steps
sessions.description: Write down the one thing you will change in 2027, and who will hold you to it.
objectives: Write one commitment for 2027
Name the person who will check on you
Agree how progress gets reported

sessions.title: Closing address
sessions.description: What we heard over three days, and what happens next.

sessions.title: Group photo and departure
sessions.description: Everyone on the ballroom steps. Please complete the event feedback form before you leave.
